note: Independently re-judged against the entire RFC 4271 Section 8.2.2 OpenConfirm Event 24 action list and the neighbouring Event 18/25 list. TestRFC4271VersionErrorNotificationReleasesQuietly/OPENCONFIRM receives NOTIFICATION 2/1 at counter 3 and requires no outgoing NOTIFICATION, TCP closure, three stopped session timers, released session, Idle and counter still 3. The close helper establishes closure rather than a read timeout, not specifically io.EOF. TestRFC4271OtherOpenErrorNotificationIsNotAVersionError/OPENCONFIRM receives 2/2 with otherwise the same setup, still sends no NOTIFICATION but must increment 3 to 4, pinning the exact distinction between the version-error and ordinary-notification lists. The retained nonzero starting counter detects both an increment on the positive and a reset/omitted increment on the negative. notificationEvent and handleOpenConfirm implement that distinct classification and no-increment arm. Approved wording/subcode changes elsewhere in the shared units do not remove these OpenConfirm assertions. Native records and the completed renewal log remain producer-dependence evidence; the separate exact counter assertions establish the semantic boundary.
